PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  23-51595  Recommendation to receive and file President’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  23-51596  Recommendation to approve the minutes of the Long Beach Community
  Investment Company meeting on November 15, 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  23-51594  Recommendation to authorize the President or designee to amend and restate the
  loan and regulatory agreements with Mental Health Association of Los Angeles for
  814 Atlantic Avenue; and

  Authorize the President or designee to execute any and all documents necessary to
  amend and restate the loan and regulatory agreements.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  23-51593  Recommendation to authorize the President or designee to negotiate and enter into
  a Disposition and Development Agreement with 225-227 E. 15th Street and 1510
  Palmer Court to Habitat for Humanity of Greater Los Angeles; and

  Approve a loan in the amount of $560,000 to Habitat for Humanity of Greater Los
  Angeles to provide gap financing for the development of 225-227 E. 15th Street and
  1510 Palmer Court; and
